title: M3.4 Scale / Release Pack arbitration and bounded design
purpose: Challenge the historical M3.4 Scale and Publishing milestone after M3.3 promotion and, only if justified, freeze the smallest useful operator-scale release capability without introducing remote publishing infrastructure.
invariants: This work package is arbitration/design only and changes no product code.
Promoted M3.2, M3.2.5 and M3.3 authorities remain read-only and authoritative.
The exact promoted M2.2 learner artifact remains unchanged.
Remote publishing, repository-write effects, backend, accounts, synchronization, catalog, marketplace and provider integration remain held.
M3.4 may compose self-verifying PASS FactoryRuns but may not create a new semantic authority.
Asset/media authoring remains deferred because learnit.kit.v2 has no current asset model.
100/500-kit evidence is engineering scale evidence only and must not be represented as semantic qualification of 100/500 real kits.
requiredEvidence: Steve/operator-value challenge identifies a current operator pain that M3.4 would remove.
Linus/architecture challenge proves a thin composition layer is sufficient.
Reliability challenge defines deterministic collision, duplication, scale and rollback behavior.
Historical M3.4 components are explicitly accepted, rejected or deferred.
Exact implementation and independent-QA writable paths are frozen if design GO.
Repository governance PASS and PR scope PASS.
adversarialTests: Challenge automatic GitHub Release or remote publication as premature repository-write scope.
Challenge any asset model that would require expanding learnit.kit.v2.
Challenge a release pack that accepts a HOLD FactoryRun.
Challenge kit bytes whose SHA-256 does not match FactoryRun generatedKit evidence.
Challenge same revision ID with conflicting digest across a release set.
Challenge duplicate package lineage ambiguity inside one release set.
Challenge claims that synthetic 500-kit scale fixtures prove semantic quality.
independentReview: Three independent challenge lenses are recorded on issue #320: operator value, architecture, and reliability/adversarial scale.
Final design must reflect their common intersection rather than preserve historical scope by default.
rollback: Revert the two design-only files. No promoted product/runtime/evidence state is changed.
